description: Request a field-service quote by trade, location, and urgency. Returns availability and quote details when available. Accepts a provisioned integration key through x-api-key or, when OAuth is enabled, a scoped self-serve OAuth token through Authorization: Bearer. MCP also accepts the provisioned key through Authorization: Bearer. Request an integration key: POST JSON to https://steadywrk.app/api/integration-key-request (GET it for the fields), or use https://steadywrk.app/developers/keys and a person reviews each request. Email fallback: hello@steadywrk.app. Over MCP, without a key, add contact_email (and optionally contact_name and company) and the request is filed for a person to answer by email. Other anonymous callers receive HTTP 401 with WWW-Authenticate. Public modeled pricing is available through dispatch.estimate.

contact_email.description: Only without a key: where a person replies with the quote. The request is filed for review.

test_mode.description: true: a test booking with your STEADYWRK key (any key, including the free one). Answered whether orders are open or not, marked test: true; nothing is dispatched, matched or charged.

trade.description: Trade code: hvac, plumbing, electrical, general_maintenance, roofing, painting, carpentry or locksmith (see dispatch.index).

name: dispatch.quote

outputSchema.description: A matched-contractor quote, a no-availability response, a filed keyless request, or a business/auth error passthrough from the downstream dispatch API.

oneOf.description: No contractor is currently available for this trade/location.
Keyless request filed: a person replies to contact_email. Carries a modeled estimate when the trade is in the public rate card.

title: Get a dispatch quote
